# bitbucket_deployment_variable (Resource)

A variable scoped to one Bitbucket Pipelines deployment environment. When secured = true, Bitbucket never returns the value again after creation, so Terraform trusts the value in your configuration/state instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_deployment_variable" "prod_db_url" {
  repository_slug  = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  environment_uuid = bitbucket_deployment_environment.production.environment_uuid
  key              = "DB_URL"
  value            = "postgres://prod-example"
  secured          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_uuid` (String) UUID of the deployment environment this variable belongs to.
- `key` (String) Variable name, as used in bitbucket-pipelines.yml.
- `repository_slug` (String) Slug of the repository the environment belongs to.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value.

### Optional

- `secured` (Boolean) If true, Bitbucket hides the value from logs and the API after creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/repository_slug/environment_uuid/variable_uuid".
- `variable_uuid` (String) Bitbucket-assigned UUID of the variable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_deployment_variable.prod_db_url payments-api/{environment-uuid}/{variable-uuid}
```
